subject: Custom language module(s) for AMBER file types for common text editors?

messages.author: Makay Murray
messages.body:
Dear AMBER Users:
I’m looking for some custom language module(s) for the files used in the AMBER suite for use in Notepad++ <
https://notepad-plus-plus.org/
> and BBedit <
http://www.barebones.com/
>, and If I’m very lucky vi <
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vi
> inside of bash.
Notepad++ and BBedit natively support colouring for common languages like HTML, bash scripts, markdown, etc… However, I have been unable to find a language module file(s) for the AMBER files <
http://ambermd.org/FileFormats.php
>. Having these custom color files would greatly increase the readability of AMBER files day-to-day. Currently they are just regular text, while my bash, perl and python scripts are very colourful and easy to read at a glance. BBedit supports “codeless language modules”
https://www.barebones.com/support/develop/clm.html�
� <
https://www.barebones.com/support/develop/clm.html
> Notepad++ supports “User defined Languages”
https://npp-user-manual.org/docs/user-defined-language-system/
<
https://npp-user-manual.org/docs/user-defined-language-system/
>
If such a module(s) exist for the text editors above can one point me in the right direction to download them? My google-fu has been unable to locate any such files. If modules do not exist where can I submit this as a ‘feature request’ for future development?
-Makay Murray BSc.
-University of Lethbridge

messages.author: Matias Machado
messages.body:
Dear Makay,
As far as I know, there aren't and probably there won't be... cause those AMBER files you are referring to aren't part of any programming language, indeed I couldn't say it's a language itself, they are just input files with a given format or keywords... but hey! if it makes your life easier and pleasant then you can be the first in making such "custom text colouring modules"...
Best regards,
Matias
